N-add05#1.zh: 哼！想用强的，看来不给你们一点教训是不行了。
N-add05#1.t: Hmph! Trying to force your way in? Looks like you need a lesson.

N-add05#2.zh: 庄客们不由分说围了上来。他们都是本分的庄户人家，打退便罢，莫伤性命。庄门前那位老者，看来便是这里的庄主。
N-add05#2.t: The farmhands closed in without a word of explanation. They are honest farm folk: drive them off, but don't take their lives. The old man at the manor gate must be the master here.

N-add05#4.zh: 胜利条件一 --- %N走到刘太公身边说明来意
N-add05#4.t: Victory 1 --- %N reaches Squire Liu and explains

N-add05#5.zh: 胜利条件二 --- 打退所有庄客（庄客体力不到四成便会收手）
N-add05#5.t: Victory 2 --- Drive off all farmhands (they give up below 40% HP)

N-add05#7.zh: 失败条件二 --- 陈达死亡

N-add05#8.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add05#9.zh: %N在混战当中被庄客打至重伤，众人只好先行撤离桃花村，后在村外十里处遭官兵伏击，%N伤重不治，史进、朱武等人被擒，刺配边疆，从此下落不明........
N-add05#9.t: %N was badly wounded in the brawl, and the group had to withdraw from Peach Blossom Village. Ten li outside the village they fell into an army ambush. %N died of his wounds; Shi Jin, Zhu Wu and the others were captured and exiled to the frontier, never to be heard from again........

N-add05#10.zh: 陈达在混战当中被庄客打至重伤，众人只好先行撤离桃花村，后在村外十里处遭官兵伏击，陈达伤重不治，史进、朱武等人被擒，刺配边疆，从此下落不明........
N-add05#10.t: Chen Da was badly wounded in the brawl, and the group had to withdraw from Peach Blossom Village. Ten li outside the village they fell into an army ambush. Chen Da died of his wounds; Shi Jin, Zhu Wu and the others were captured and exiled to the frontier, never to be heard from again........

N-add05#11.zh: 退下！不得无礼！老汉是这桃花村的家长，大家当叫我刘太公。请问诸位的姓名是？
N-add05#11.t: Stand back! Mind your manners! I am the head of Peach Blossom Village. Folk call me Squire Liu. And who might you all be?

N-add05#12.zh: 我们是要去延安府办货的商人，我是王大，其余是史二、朱三、陈四、杨五 。错过旅店，希望能留宿一夜；适才多有冒犯，还望太公勿怪。
N-add05#12.t: We are merchants on our way to Yan'an to buy goods. I'm Wang the Eldest, and these are Shi the Second, Zhu the Third, Chen the Fourth and Yang the Fifth. We missed the inn and hope to stay the night. Forgive us for the trouble just now, sir.

N-add05#13.zh: 唉...罢了！众位就权且留宿一夜吧。不过，今夜如果听到什么声响，千万不要出来探个究竟...
N-add05#13.t: Sigh... very well! You may stay the night. But if you hear any noise tonight, whatever you do, don't come out to look...

N-add05#14.zh: 敢问贵庄今夜有什么事？
N-add05#14.t: May I ask what's happening at your manor tonight?

N-add05#15.t: ...Tonight my daughter takes a husband. That is what troubles me.

N-add05#16.zh: 男大当婚，女大当嫁；这是天经地义的事。太公何须烦恼？
N-add05#16.t: Men marry and women wed; that's the way of heaven and earth. Why should that trouble you, sir?

N-add05#17.zh: 唉...你有所不知，这门亲事不是心甘情愿的。
N-add05#17.t: Sigh... you don't understand. This match is not of our choosing.

N-add05#19.zh: 反正事情都到这个地步，老汉就一五一十地说出来吧！老汉膝下只有一女，年方十九。附近有一座桃花山，近来山上有两个大王，扎了山寨，聚集五七百人，四处打家劫舍，十分凶狠；前几日到老汉庄上收取保护费，看到老汉女儿，撇下二十两金子，一疋红锦作为聘礼。选定良辰吉日，今夜要来入赘。此等杀人不眨眼的魔君，老汉哪敢跟他理论啊？就是因此而烦恼。
N-add05#19.t: Since it has come to this, I'll tell you everything! I have only one daughter, nineteen years old. Nearby is Peach Blossom Mountain, where two bandit kings recently built a stronghold. They gather five to seven hundred men and raid all around, very fierce. A few days ago they came to collect protection money, saw my daughter, and threw down twenty taels of gold and a bolt of red brocade as a betrothal gift. They picked an auspicious day, and tonight he comes to marry into the family. How could an old man argue with a demon who kills without blinking? That is my trouble.

N-add05#20.t: Taking a girl by force? Outrageous!

N-add05#21.zh: 如果太公不嫌弃，我们五人都学过功夫；如果有用得着我们的地方，我们可以助一臂之力。
N-add05#21.t: If you don't mind, sir, all five of us know some kung fu. If we can be of use, we'd gladly lend a hand.

N-add05#22.zh: 与这种强盗打交道，能够不出人命是最好的...前日从五台山来了一个菩萨，自愿今晚以高深佛法劝说强人回心转意，皈依我佛；老汉一生向佛，今日遇此危难，却遇得此活佛相救，真是老天有眼...
N-add05#22.t: With bandits like these, it's best if no one gets killed... The day before yesterday a holy man came from Mount Wutai. He offered to use the profound Dharma tonight to persuade the bandit to turn back and take refuge in the Buddha. I've been devout all my life, and in my hour of need a living Buddha has come to save me. Heaven truly has eyes...

N-add05#23.zh: (俺才不信！佛法要是这么便利，那么世上哪里还有强盗山贼！)
N-add05#23.t: (I don't believe it! If the Dharma were that handy, there'd be no bandits left in the world!)

N-add05#24.zh: 总之，诸位就安静地住在客房；迎亲的事就不用你们操心。
N-add05#24.t: In any case, please stay quietly in the guest rooms. Don't trouble yourselves about the wedding.

N-add05#25.zh: 刘太公出面化解纷争，众英雄欲伸张正义。
N-add05#25.t: Squire Liu settles the quarrel, and our heroes resolve to see justice done.

N-add05#26.zh: 老丈！我等只是路过借宿的客商，并无恶意，还请喝住贵庄的庄客！
N-add05#26.t: Good sir! We're only merchants passing through looking for a bed. We mean no harm. Please call off your farmhands!
